about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-78, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 1 day.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Coverage closure: every inventoried facilitator, chain, language, scheme and extension has evidence or a stated reason
tasks.description: The 'cover ALL' claim in one gate. It can only be claimed when the ledger is closed; the README may then say 'every implementation in the public inventory of <date> has evidence or a stated reason', never 'certified' or 'compliant'.

criteria.statement: The ledger has zero rows in state 'task'; every row is evidence or out-of-reach with a reason from the fixed list
Every evidence folder verifies and passes the testnet, loopback and verify-only guard (settles only where a task allowed them)
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
